list.title: Campaigns
list.description: Configure the goal, audience, one message, and send rules; run after approval.
list.emptyDescription: Campaigns are built in six steps. Channels the provider has not allowed show a blocking banner at the top.

builder.title: New campaign
builder.description: Configure in six steps, then freeze and request approval.
builder.name: Campaign name
builder.objectivePlaceholder: e.g. Connect pre-verified targets to consult meetings
builder.channelBlockedHint: This channel is not allowed. Only saving/draft is possible; freeze and approval requests are blocked.
builder.mailboxReauthRequired: This mailbox needs to reconnect. Campaign creation may be blocked until access is restored.
builder.noChannels: No channels for the marketing purpose. Review channels under Operations & settings.
builder.immediateMessageHint: This message is sent as soon as the approved launch reaches its send window.
builder.zohoImmediateMessageHint: After Office approval, an Admin prepares a one-time export and explicitly sends it through the free Campaigns API.
builder.zohoStopConditions: Zoho Campaigns sends one bulk campaign. Office cannot stop individual messages after provider submission, so reply and booking stop controls are unavailable.
builder.zohoImmediateOnly: Free Zoho Campaigns uses one immediate bulk send after approval. Schedule days, windows, caps, and local stop automation are unavailable.
builder.meetingTypeHint: Optional. This type is used to create per-recipient booking links when selected templates use the booking URL variable.
builder.meetingTypeRequiredHint: Choose an active meeting type because a selected template uses the booking URL variable.
builder.meetingTypesLoadFailed: Meeting types could not be loaded. Check your access and try again.
builder.noActiveMeetingTypes: No active meeting types are available.
builder.internalCapNote: This is the app's internal policy cap, not a provider allowance.
builder.validationAudience: Select at least one recipient address.
builder.validationSteps: Choose a template version for the message.
builder.validationMeetingTypeRequired: Select an active meeting type for the template’s booking link.
builder.lockedNote: The draft is already created. To change the configuration, finish and edit as a new revision.
builder.sourceMissing: Source campaign not found. It was deleted or you do not have access.
builder.legacyWorkflowDescription: Its {count} stored message step(s) and delays are preserved. Follow-up automation has been retired, so this revision cannot be edited or launched. Create a new campaign with one immediate message.
builder.validationWindow: End time must be after start time.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Search contacts and pick unique email addresses. Suppressions, unverified basis, and duplicates are excluded at preflight.
audience.searchPlaceholder: Search contacts by name or company…
audience.dupNote: If an address is linked to multiple contacts, only one enrollment per address is included in the launch.
audience.emptyDescription: Change the search or register contacts first.

preflight.title: Audience preflight
preflight.description: A non-binding check, not execution authorization. Re-evaluated at freeze, approval, and send.
preflight.notAuthorization: This result is not execution authorization.

detail.notFoundDescription: It was deleted or you do not have mailbox access.
detail.freezeDescription: Fixes the full audience, every step's actual content, sender, and rules hash. Recipients and content cannot change after freeze.
detail.preflightFirst: Review the preflight result before freezing.
detail.noEligibleRecipients: No addresses passed preflight. Update the audience and run preflight again before freezing.
detail.approvalReasonPlaceholder: I reviewed the recipients and the actual send content.
detail.approvalRequestDescription: A different active approver reviews the frozen snapshot. You cannot approve your own request.
detail.cancelDescription: Only sends that have not executed are canceled. Messages already submitted externally cannot be recalled.
detail.inFlightNote: Items past the submission boundary (in-flight) are not canceled and are shown separately.
detail.approvalPending: Awaiting approval. Another approver reviews it in the approvals inbox.
detail.conflictDescription: Load the latest state and try again.
detail.versionFrozen: Steps and recipients of a frozen parent cannot change.

marketingExport.title: Office-owned Campaigns delivery
marketingExport.description: Prepare the frozen Office launch for {connection}. Office owns the subject, HTML and recipient values.
marketingExport.connectBeforeExport: Reconnect or connect an active Campaigns account in Settings before preparing this export.
marketingExport.setupFailed: Could not check the Campaigns connection.
marketingExport.prepareFailed: The Office export could not be prepared. Retry to check the same request.
marketingExport.topicsLoadFailed: Topics could not be loaded. You can enter a topic ID below.
marketingExport.advanced: Advanced: map Office variables to verified Zoho fields
marketingExport.fieldMapHint: Use a field_name from the list below for contact_field. Enter each merge_tag exactly as verified in this Zoho account (for example $[UD:OFFICE_BOOKING_URL]$). Tags with fallback values are not supported.
marketingExport.fieldsLoadFailed: Contact fields could not be loaded.
marketingExport.noFields: No contact fields were returned for this account.
marketingExport.mappingVerified: I verified each contact field and merge tag in this Zoho Campaigns account.
marketingExport.verifyMappings: Verify the field names and merge tags in this account before using the mapping.
marketingExport.invalidFieldMap: Enter a valid JSON object with a contact field and merge tag for every variable.
marketingExport.exportLoadFailed: Could not load the Office export.
marketingExport.subject: Subject
marketingExport.nativeUnsubscribe: Native unsubscribe is included in each exported message.
marketingExport.sourceChanged: This export does not match the current frozen Office source. Refresh or prepare the matching source before continuing.
marketingExport.approvalRequired: Sending stays locked until this Office launch is approved.
marketingExport.writeScopeTitle: Reconnect this Campaigns account to sync drafts
marketingExport.writeScopeRequired: This connection does not have draft-write access yet. Reconnect it in Settings before continuing the contact sync.
marketingExport.syncFailed: Could not sync the draft. Retry uses the same request key.
marketingExport.previewFailed: Could not load the exported HTML.
marketingExport.previewHashMismatch: The preview hash does not match this export. Sending is blocked.
marketingExport.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the export status.
marketingExport.sendRejected: Zoho rejected the send request. Refresh the export status before trying again.
marketingExport.sendOutcomeUnknown: Provider outcome is unknown. Refresh the export status before taking any further action.
marketingExport.priorOptOutScanProgress: Zoho opt-out status is still being checked. No email was sent. Review the refreshed export, then type SEND again to continue.
marketingExport.sendNeedsReviewNoSubmission: This export needs review before it can be sent. No email was submitted. Continue the export and send only after it returns READY.

channelGate.title: Delivery channel is blocked
channelGate.description: Provider policy or connection state does not allow this campaign. Freeze, approval, and execution are blocked; saving/draft only.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: The input is invalid. Check the field-level errors.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.MAILBOX_ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have access to this mailbox.
errors.VERSION_MISMATCH: Someone else saved first. Load the latest state.
errors.VERSION_PRECONDITION_REQUIRED: Version information is required. Refresh and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: A different request was already received with this key.
errors.REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS: The same request is being processed. Check its status shortly.
errors.APPROVAL_EXPIRED: The approval validity expired. A new approval request is needed.
errors.SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH: Differs from the frozen snapshot. Review the new snapshot.
errors.RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED: A suppressed address is included. Remove it from the audience.
errors.SEND_BASIS_UNVERIFIED: Some addresses lack a verified send basis.
errors.PROVIDER_POLICY_BLOCKED: Provider policy blocks sending for this purpose.
errors.PROVIDER_POLICY_UNVERIFIED: Provider policy is not verified yet.
errors.RECIPIENT_ACTIVE_ELSEWHERE: Some addresses are active in another campaign.
errors.WORKSPACE_EMERGENCY_STOP: The workspace is in emergency stop. Submissions stay halted until resumed.
errors.INTEGRATION_REAUTH_REQUIRED: Integration re-authentication is required. Notify the connection admin.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
errors.DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: A dependency is unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL: A server error occurred. Contact support with the request ID.
errors.UNKNOWN: The request could not be processed. Please try again.
